entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I... I think I need to return something. My VeloBand Pulse monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's not broken. It's just... it's really hard to use. The whole interface is so confusing. I really expected more, you know?
I'm sorry to hear it's not meeting your expectations. When you say confusing, are you referring to a specific feature, like tracking workouts or viewing your heart rate data?
Everything, really. I tried reading the user manual, but it just didn't help. I just want to send it back. I'm a bit overwhelmed by it all. Can't you just help me?
Of course. I understand completely. Let me just pull up your order details and check the return eligibility for you. One moment please.
Alright, I see here that you received the VeloBand Pulse 32 days ago. Let me just confirm the policy... Okay, yes. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery.
Oh! Really? So it's not too late? I can still return it?
That's correct. You are well within the 90-day window. I can process this return for you right now and I'll email you a prepaid shipping label immediately.
Wow, that's such a relief. Thank you so much, David. I was really worried I'd be stuck with it.

It's my pleasure to help. The email is on its way. Just print the label, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
No, that's perfect. You've been a great help. Thanks again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
